title: Deliver the mail. Now catch the boat!
hook: After delivering letters, these carriers jump back onto a moving mailboat
summary: On Geneva Lake in Wisconsin, summer mail carriers jump between docks and a moving boat. If they miss the return jump, the captain comes back for them.

text: On Geneva Lake in Wisconsin, a mailboat visits lakeside homes in summer.
A carrier jumps from the moving boat onto a dock, delivers letters and picks up outgoing mail.

panels.text: Excuse me! Your coworker is still ashore!

text: Then it's time to jump back onto the boat, which is still moving. The letters have arrived. The carrier is chasing the ride.
It's real mail delivery, not a movie shoot. Passengers ride along to watch, too.
Nobody gets abandoned. If a carrier misses the return jump, the captain comes back to pick them up.

panels.text: Delivery complete. Please collect the carrier next.
